sloka: नूनम् व्यकरणम् कृत्स्नम् अनेन बहुधा श्रुतम् ।बहु व्याहरता अनेन न किंचित् अप शब्दितम् ॥४-३-२९॥
transliteration: nūnam vyakaraṇam kṛtsnam anena bahudhā śrutam ।bahu vyāharatā anena na kiṁcit apa śabditam ॥4-3-29॥

translations.english: 'Surely, he seems to have studied well the whole of grammar, for there is not a single mispronunciation in his entire speech.
